Pal Warns of Four-Year Window to Build Wealth
On Saturday, in a post on
, Pal shared a clip from his interview on the When Shift Happens podcast, warning that people have a limited window to prepare for major economic changes.
“We have about four years. Four years to get yourself sorted before the economy starts to work in ways none of us are used to,” he wrote.
Pal said people would still be able to invest afterward, but cautioned that “the rules will be different.”
He pointed to technology and scarce assets as potential ways to navigate the changing economic landscape.
Pal Warns AI Agents Could Reshape Financial Markets
During the interview, Pal explained that money primarily provides financial security before allowing people to improve their lifestyles.

He also discussed why people increasingly feel their financial futures have been taken away from them, saying he wrote his book, The Everything Code, to explain what is happening and how people can prepare.
“We’re kind of setting up this is it. This is the one,” Pal said, urging people to use the current period to position themselves for the future.
He also warned that investors could eventually find themselves “competing with agents,” suggesting AI-powered systems could fundamentally change financial markets.
